title: The Impossible task for one man
subtitle: 困难与应对 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）
meta: 主题语境：困难与应对（做人与做事·困难与应对）　|　核心词汇：impossible　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 impossible 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1959 the baker wrote of ① an impossible task for one man in the bill, and everybody in the bakery said at once that it was ② so impossible that nobody in the bakery would go near it. Three weeks on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the baker, who never explained anything, had done it in public and gone home; it was the impossible ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the impossible task for one man that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill for December 1953 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too impossible to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the customer who had come to help; the impossible ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the tray at the far oven, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ an impossible child at the table, and said that no customer in his right mind would call it ⑥ as impossible as the child at the table they had once had in the old bakery. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was impossible or not, and he said so.

By 1966 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the bill. What the line asked for was ⑦ something impossible, and nothing besides. The customer from the next bakery called the whole plan ⑧ quite impossible; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the bill kept the names of the impossible ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1969, in silence, she wrote of another impossible task for one man in the same bill, and the work, which took two weeks, seemed ⑨ no less impossible than anybody had expected. ⑩ The impossible child at the table that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1971, was the one she could never quite name; the impossible ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 不可能（前置定语 an impossible task for one man：1959 年面点师在账单里记下的那件不可能的活）
B. adj. 不可能／难以忍受（两处加强说法：so impossible that … 与 no less impossible than …）
C. adj. 不可能／难以忍受（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 不可能（表语 too impossible to do：母亲觉得它太不可能，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 难以忍受（前置定语 an impossible child at the table：叔叔把整件事称作一桩难以忍受的孩子）
F. adj. 难以忍受（同级比较 as impossible as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩饭桌上难缠的孩子相比）
G. adj. 难以忍受（后置定语 something impossible：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 难以忍受（受程度副词修饰 quite impossible：那位顾客的评价）

items.q: an impossible task for one man
the impossible task for one man that
an impossible child at the table
The impossible child at the table that

answers.why: impossible 意为“不可能”，1959 年面点师在账单里记下的是“一件不可能的活”，此处作前置定语 an impossible task for one man。
impossible 意为“不可能”，此处用 so impossible that 结构，说它不可能到糕饼铺里没人敢靠近。
impossible 意为“不可能”，账单上 十二月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的不可能一个人做不来的活，等于最高级的说法。
impossible 意为“不可能”，母亲认为这件东西“太不可能了，谁也用不上”，too impossible to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩难以忍受的孩子”，此处作前置定语 an impossible child at the table。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩饭桌上难缠的孩子一样难以忍受”，同级比较用 as impossible as。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，账单上那半行字要的是“难以忍受的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something impossible。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，邻糕饼铺来的那位顾客认为这套计划“相当难以忍受”，quite 修饰原级 impossible。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，no less impossible than 表示“其难以忍受不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之难以忍受不亚于任何人的预料。
impossible 意为“难以忍受”，母亲 1971 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的难以忍受孩子”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1959 年，面点师在账单里记下了一件不可能的活。（an impossible task for one man）
它不可能到糕饼铺里没有一个人敢靠近。（so impossible that …）
母亲觉得它太不可能，谁也用不上。（too impossible to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩难以忍受的孩子。（an impossible child at the table）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩饭桌上难缠的孩子一样难以忍受。（as impossible as …）
到了 1966 年，账单上只剩半行字：要的是一件难以忍受的东西。（something impossible）
answers: In 1959 the baker wrote of an impossible task for one man in the bill.
It was so impossible that nobody in the bakery would go near it.
My mother thought it too impossible to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business an impossible child at the table.
He said nobody would call it as impossible as the child at the table they had once had.
By 1966 the bill asked for nothing but something impossible.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 impossible 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1959 the baker wrote of an impossible task for one man in the bill, and nobody forgot it.
It was the impossible task for one man that anybody there had ever seen, or so the bill says.
My mother thought it too impossible to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business an impossible child at the table, and nobody argued with him.
The customer from the next bakery called the plan quite impossible, and everybody laughed.
The impossible ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
